desc.text: The hunting bands of the white valleys were cutting a path across the old ice when they found a man inside it, laid out like a drowned log and warm as a sleeper. When they broke him free, he breathed. He does not know his name, or ours, and he has no tongue that any of us can answer.

Our herders, crossing the old ice with their sleds, found a man set in it as a stone is set in a wall. He was small, for one of ours to carry, and warm. When they cut him out, he breathed. He does not know his name, or ours, and he has no tongue that any of us can answer.

Hunters cutting a path across the old ice found a man inside it, laid out like a drowned log and warm as a sleeper. When the clan broke him free, he breathed. He does not know his name, or ours, and he has no tongue that any of us can answer.

options.name: Nurse the stranger.
options.tip: He will stay among us as a guest, and remember it.

options.name: Bind him to our service.
options.tip: He stays a year, and does not forget how.

events.title: Old Siula's Tale
events.desc: Old Siula, who found him, tells it at every fire: the ice was older than her grandmother's grandmother, and the man in it was warm as new bread. The children ask what he dreamed. She says that is the one thing he cannot tell, and that she has stopped asking.

events.title: The Man from the Ice Learns Our Words
events.desc: In two months he speaks our tongue as if he had always known it, and a few words he should not know. He hunts better than our best. He shares the meat, and eats last.

options.name: He is one of us now.
He is a guest, not a son.

events.title: Talk of a Man from the Ice
events.title_note: the second firing, 90 days after a summons, carries the flag zin_eindil_summoned

desc.text: The northern guest has sat at our table for a season. He has asked to go south with the traders before the snows close the Neck Road. He does not say why. We think he does not know.
Hunters from the north-west tell of a man cut alive from old ice, stronger than three men and gentler than one. At the Winter Court some laugh. Some listen.

options.name: Summon him to court.
options.tip: He may come, and he will stay a season.

options.name: Send the wardens to watch over him.
options.tip: Coldor's wardens will watch over him.

options.name: Let him go with our thanks.

events.title: The Traders' Road South
events.desc: Western traders are going south before the snows. The stranger asks to go with them. He wants to know who he is, and every story of men that he has heard begins in the south.

options.name: Give him furs and provisions.
options.tip: He will leave with our goodwill.

options.name: Let him go as he came.

events.title: Traders Bring a Stranger
events.to: owner of zin_is_site_three_oaths; Coldor with the Neck Road
events.desc: A trading caravan has come over the Neck Road with a tall man from the north who works for his bread and asks questions about Aen. The drivers say he has not told them his own name, and that they have stopped asking him to.

events.title: The Bridge of the Three Oaths
events.desc: Two lordships meet on the old bridge with torches, each come to burn the other's granary after a bad harvest. The stranger from the north, walking south with the traders, stands in the middle of the planks and asks them to count the bread first.

options.name: Burn the grain anyway.
options.tip: Burned granaries will weigh on us for half a year.

events.title: The Bread Counted
events.to: the other lordship, if different from the host
events.desc: Our lord kept his granary, and the neighbour who came with a torch went home with a loaf. The tale of the bridge is told in both halls now, and each tells it so that its own lord looks wiser.

events.title: Girdon's Winter Ford
events.desc: The ford is breaking up under the ice, and a column of refugees is still on it. The stranger stands in the freezing water to his chest and holds the last cart until the children are across.

options.name: Hold the ford open for them.
options.tip: The refugees will settle on our side of the river.

events.title: The Refugees Settle
events.desc: The refugees from the ford have built a village on our bank. They have named its well after the stranger, whose name they do not know, and so it is called the Well of the Man Who Stood in the Water.

events.title: Judgment in Gunwaith
events.to: Gunwaith, or the owner of its former capital
events.desc: The stranger beat three champions hired by a Gunwaith thane to settle a quarrel with a neighbour. Now the thane demands that he be tried for the champions' broken bones. The stranger agrees, and asks only that the law be the same for him as for any man in the hall.

options.name: Try him fairly.
options.tip: The judgment will be remembered for a year.

options.name: Make an example of him.
options.tip: He is held half a year, and Gunwaith is not thanked for it.

options.name: Pardon him.
options.tip: He refuses to be spared a trial that others would face.

desc.text: Lawspeaker Ilurda rules: the stranger owes the thane a season's labour and nothing more. He pays it in a month, rebuilding the bridge that the champions broke, and the thane is seen to nod at the work.
The lawspeaker rules: the stranger owes the thane a season's labour and nothing more. He pays it in a month, rebuilding the bridge that the champions broke, and the thane is seen to nod at the work.

events.title: The King Without a House
events.to: the countries the journey picks (every West Lands country once his renown is 20, otherwise the hosts of the road)
events.desc: From the Bridge of the Three Oaths to the courts of Gunwaith, people speak of [zin_loc_eindil], who makes peace and asks for nothing. Some call him the King Without a House. He has been seen at the fords of three rivers and has never slept under a roof that was offered twice.

options.name: A good man, wherever he is from.

events.title: The Grey Ford Breaks
events.to: leader of the Grey Ford Confederation
events.desc: Gunwaith and Girdon are fighting at the Grey Ford again, and the crowns between them cannot stop it alone. Someone at our council table says what everyone has been thinking since the autumn: ask the stranger.

events.title: Feud on the Grey Ford
events.to: leader of the Grey Ford Confederation
events.desc: A border feud at the Grey Ford threatens the truce that Gunwaith and Girdon signed five years ago. No banners have moved, but the quarrel has drawn blood. The crowns between ask the stranger to stand between the two.

events.title: A Crown Offered
events.to: leader of the Grey Ford Confederation
events.desc: The confederation offers the stranger a war-king's crown for as long as it takes to make the peace, and not one day longer. He has said that he will carry it only so. The council wants to know whether we will lay it before him.

options.name: Refuse the stranger.
options.tip: The offer passes to the next court.

if: any_country = { has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_eindil_refused_crown } NOT = { original_tag = ROOT } check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard > -0.001 } }

options.name: Name him war-king.
options.tip: The confederation marches under his banner for one season.

events.title: The Confederation Gathers
events.to: each confederation member except the leader
events.desc: Our banners will march under the stranger's for one season. Our captains want to know if he can lead, and they have asked whether he can be made to explain where he learned to hold a line.

events.title: The War-King's Terms
events.desc: The war-king's host stands between the two armies at the Grey Ford. He offers terms: the old border, the dead buried, the prisoners sent home. He asks both sides to sign, and he asks it of each in the same words.

options.name: Accept his peace.
options.tip: When both sides accept, the war at the ford ends.

options.name: Fight on.
options.tip: The war goes on, and the stranger will remember who refused him.

events.title: A Feast at the Ford
events.desc: Gunwaith's thanes and Girdon's wardens eat at one table at the ford for the first time in fifty years. The war-king sits at the foot of it, not the head, and carves the meat for others before he eats.

do: ROOT = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_eindil_feast_at_the_ford } }

events.title: The Crown Laid Down
events.to: leader of the Grey Ford Confederation
events.desc: The war-king sets the crown on the council table and asks for a horse and a road to the sea. He wants to cross to the old kingdom of Aen, he says, and see whether anything of it remains.

options.name: Release him with honour.
options.tip: The West will remember the war-king.

options.name: Try to keep the war-king.
options.tip: He leaves by night, and the confederation dissolves.

events.title: The War-King Lays Down His Crown
events.desc: In the West a stranger made a peace that no king could make, and then gave the crown back. Taverns from the Grey Ford to the western shore argue about where he came from. Nobody knows his name.
